author: Katharine Shaw
text:
I’m not an expert but I think you’ve probably touched a sensory nerve close to the skin surface.  As long as it’s bearable, I’d suggest you carry on using the sensor.  

When you take it off you may find you’ve also had a bit of bleeding which means you’ve gone through a blood vessel as this can also be painful. 

It’s a hazard of using anything that pierces the skin but the sensor itself is sterile so you’re not introducing any infection and the damage will heal probably in a few days.
